title: Contrastive latent representation learning with denoising score matching
abstract: arXiv:2611.18469v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Contrastive representation learning methods operate by pulling different views of the same data sample together while pushing them away from views of different samples. A fundamental challenge is the estimation of the repulsive force, which typically requires large batch sizes, can exhibit high variance, and is susceptible to the curse of dimensionality. We introduce ScoreCLR, a contrastive representation learning method that offers a novel way to estimate this repulsion term. We consider the framework of representation learning by maximizing the mutual information between two latent views of a sample. By deriving the gradient of the Shannon entropy with respect to the encoder parameters, we obtain an equivalent objective that involves the score of the latent representation. translated_title: 基于去噪分数匹配的对比潜在表示学习
translated_abstract: 对比表示学习方法通过将同一样本的不同视图拉近，同时将其与不同样本的视图推开来进行学习。一个根本性的挑战在于对排斥力的估计，这通常需要较大的批处理规模，可能表现出高方差，并且容易受到维度灾难的影响。我们提出了ScoreCLR，这是一种对比表示学习方法，为估计这一排斥项提供了一种新颖的方式。我们考虑了通过最大化样本两个潜在视图之间互信息来进行表示学习的框架。通过推导香农熵关于编码器参数的梯度，我们得到了一个涉及潜在表示分数的等价目标函数。随后，我们使用去噪分数匹配技术，通过一个与编码器联合训练的轻量级网络来估计该分数。我们还进一步提出了正则化方法（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出ScoreCLR方法，通过推导香农熵梯度得到涉及潜在表示分数的等价目标，并利用去噪分数匹配技术由轻量级网络与编码器联合训练来估计排斥项，从而以新颖方式克服了对比学习中排斥力估计依赖大批量、高方差和维度灾难的问题。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces ScoreCLR, which derives an equivalent objective involving the score of the latent representation via the gradient of Shannon entropy and estimates it with denoising score matching using a lightweight network jointly trained with the encoder, offering a novel way to estimate the repulsive term in contrastive representation learning without relying on large batch sizes.
